category_edits.rationale: Test masked-target cross-entropy temperature 0.85 across all four categories. This modest softening differs from the previously evaluated label smoothing and temperature configurations, and may improve generalization. Preserve global masked-target averaging, zero label smoothing, sampling, architecture, optimizer and inference.

change_summary: Change only the shared masked-item loss temperature from 0.8 to 0.85. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain compatible.
